title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a public-benefit fund
friendlyTitle: Anthropic sets aside 5% of its shares for public benefit
summary: Anthropic said on 18 October that, subject to stockholder approval, 5% of its shares will go to a new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund. The board may add another 2% for every 50% rise in company value above a baseline it has not yet published. The fund will be a wholly owned LLC, not a charity. Anthropic says the equity will not be used for lobbying or political donations. Combined with an earlier founder pledge and an employee match, it says about 20% of shares would be set aside for public benefit, before any later additions.

whyItMatters: The announcement names possible uses, including donations or direct payments if AI unsettles work, but it does not yet say who governs the fund or which valuation triggers add shares. Those details are promised for the coming months. Until then, this is a commitment of equity, not a finished giving program.
